description: This file implements a microsecond timer using a 32-bit hardware timer, including functions for setting the timer, handling callbacks, and a watchdog controller for monitoring timer activity.

classes.name: MicrosecondTimerWatchdogController
classes.description: A periodic controller class that monitors the timer activity and triggers errors if the timer is inactive for too long.

methods.name: setHardwareUsTimer
methods.description: Sets the hardware timer alarm to trigger after a specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: initMicrosecondTimer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the microsecond timer hardware and associated watchdog.
